notes: Mina's vegetarian diet is never stated outright. It has to be inferred from 'i could order off the whole board for once', which comes after Liam mentions the tofu versions. Most players will get it, but it is the softest clue in the chat. Stone Well's second review fits it well, since it mentions a friend 'who doesn't eat meat'.
Cyrus's allergy is also implied rather than named ('we're skipping every one of those for you'), but the reviews make it clear enough.
Brooke's preference is clear, and Liam's fryer line confirms it.
The decoys work well: each one fails exactly one constraint, and Plum Bridge and Red Thread are tempting safe picks that only miss the cuisine.

Banyan Kitchen's id starts with 'downtown_' even though it is listed in the night_market registry, and its review says it is a night cart of a downtown lunch counter. This is consistent in the fiction, but the id looks odd. I did not use it to make the pick.
